Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating insurable interests and employer-owned life insurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to insurable interests and employerowned lifeinsurance; amending RCW 48.18.010, 48.18.030, and 48.18.060; and addingnew sections to chapter 48.18 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) "Employerowned life insurance policy" as used in this sectionand section 5 of this act means an insurance policy purchased by anemployer on the life of an employee, for the benefit of a person otherthan the employee or the employee's personal representative. (2) An employerowned life insurance policy may not be made or takeeffect unless at the time the contract is made the individual insuredconsents to the contract in writing. (3) An employer may not retaliate in any manner against an employeefor providing written notice that he or she does not want to be insuredunder an employerowned life insurance policy. (4) No later than thirty days after the date on which an employerpurchases an employerowned life insurance policy on the life of anemployee, the employer must provide to the employee a written noticethat contains the following information: (a) A statement that the employer carries an employerowned lifeinsurance policy on the life of the employee; (b) The identity of the insurance carrier of the policy; (c) The maximum face amount of the policy at issue; and (d) The identity of the beneficiary of the policy.
